faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about GENOSYS products, shipping, orders, our mobile app, and professional training.

whatIsGenosys.a: GENOSYS is a professional Korean dermacosmetics brand distributed by GENOSYS Middle East FZ-LLC in the UAE. We offer premium skincare products and microneedling devices for professional use. Our products are certified by Dubai Municipality and are suitable for licensed practitioners and professional beauty clinics.

shipToAllEmirates.q: Do you ship to all UAE emirates?
shipToAllEmirates.a:
Yes, we ship to all 7 UAE emirates. Shipping rates:
- Dubai: 45 AED (1–2 hours via Careem/QuipQup)
- Abu Dhabi: 70 AED (24–36 hours)
- Sharjah: 70 AED (24–36 hours)
- Ajman: 70 AED (24–36 hours)
- Ras Al Khaimah: 70 AED (24–36 hours)
- Fujairah: 70 AED (24–36 hours)
- Umm Al Quwain: 70 AED (24–36 hours)
Orders over 1,000 AED qualify for free shipping across all emirates.

suitableForHomeUse.q: Are GENOSYS products suitable for home use?
suitableForHomeUse.a: GENOSYS offers both professional-grade products for licensed practitioners and homecare products for personal use. Please check product descriptions for usage guidelines. Some products are specifically designed for professional treatments and should only be used by trained practitioners.

paymentMethods.q: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.a: We accept two payment methods: Card Payment online (Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Google Pay) and Cash on Delivery (COD). You can choose your preferred method at checkout.

shippingTime.a:
Delivery times by emirate:
- Dubai: 1–2 hours (same-day express via Careem/QuipQup)
- Abu Dhabi & Al Ain: 24–36 hours
- Sharjah: 24–36 hours
- Ajman: 24–36 hours
- Ras Al Khaimah: 24–36 hours
- Fujairah: 24–36 hours
- Umm Al Quwain: 24–36 hours
We process all orders on the same day. Free shipping is available for orders over 1,000 AED.

returnExchange.q: Can I return or exchange products?
returnExchange.a: We accept returns and exchanges within 7 days of delivery for unopened products in their original packaging. Please contact our support team at sales@genosys.ae or WhatsApp +971 58 548 76 65 to initiate a return or exchange.

professionalTraining.a: Yes, we offer comprehensive professional skincare training for licensed practitioners, clinics and beauty salons. Our training includes microneedling techniques, product application methods, treatment protocols, on-site training, live product demonstrations, hands-on treatment sessions, and personalized team guidance.

productsCertified.a: Yes, all GENOSYS products are certified by Dubai Municipality and comply with UAE regulations. We are the official distributor of DTS MG Co., Ltd. Korea in the UAE, ensuring authentic and certified products.

trackOrder.q: How do I track my order?
trackOrder.a: Once your order is confirmed, you will receive an order confirmation email with your order number. Our support team will contact you via phone, email, or WhatsApp to confirm delivery details. You can also contact us directly with your order number for updates.

returnPolicy.a: We accept returns within 7 days of delivery for unopened products. Products must be in their original packaging and unused. Refunds will be processed within 5-7 business days after we receive the returned items.

bulkDiscounts.a: Yes, we offer discounts for bulk orders and professional accounts. Registered users may be eligible for special pricing based on their account type. Contact our sales team at sales@genosys.ae to discuss bulk order pricing.

becomeRegistered.q: How do I become a registered user?
becomeRegistered.a: You can register for an account on our website by clicking the "Login" button and selecting "Register". Registration is free and gives you access to product pricing, professional training materials, and exclusive member benefits.

sensitiveSkin.q: Are your products suitable for sensitive skin?
sensitiveSkin.a: Many GENOSYS products are formulated for sensitive skin, but we recommend consulting with a dermatologist or skincare professional before use. Product descriptions include information about skin types and target concerns. Always perform a patch test before first use.

internationalShipping.a: Currently, GENOSYS Middle East FZ-LLC only ships within the United Arab Emirates. However, we have offices around the globe, and GENOSYS products are likely available in your country through our international network of distributors.

contactSupport.q: How can I contact customer support?
contactSupport.a: You can reach our customer support team via email at sales@genosys.ae, WhatsApp at +971 58 548 76 65, Instagram at @genosys.uae, or through our contact page. Our support team is available Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 9 PM UAE time.

whyChooseGenosys.a: GENOSYS stands out for several key reasons: Skin-friendly formulations, highly effective products, affordable pricing strategy, same-day delivery, certified and authentic products, expert support, and comprehensive product range.

haveBlog.a: Yes! Our GENOSYS Blog features expert insights on Korean skincare, professional dermacosmetics, beauty industry trends, and product information. Learn about the latest innovations, skincare tips, ingredient benefits, and treatment protocols.

deleteAccount.a: Yes, you can delete your account at any time. Go to your Profile and select "Delete Account". Once confirmed, all your personal data — including order history, saved addresses, and preferences — will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone. If you need assistance, contact our support team at sales@genosys.ae or WhatsApp +971 58 548 76 65.

product.collagenInduction: Promotion of collagen induction and skin regeneration:
product.documentationDescription: Download the complete product manual and usage guide for professional application.
product.routineSnowO2Desc: Start your routine by cleansing your face with Snow O₂. Apply to dry skin, wait for oxygen bubbles to form, then gently massage and rinse with lukewarm water.
product.routineSnowBoosterDescAntiAging: After cleansing, apply the toner to moisturize and refine skin texture. It helps balance pH level and prepares your skin for the anti-aging treatment.
product.routineAntiWrinkleSerumDesc: Apply the serum to visibly smooth wrinkles and reinforce skin firmness. The bakuchiol and anti-aging peptide complex work together to improve skin age index and reduce signs of aging.
product.routineAntiWrinkleCreamDesc: Finish with the cream to lock in the anti-aging benefits and provide ongoing protection. It continues to smooth wrinkles and enhance skin firmness throughout the day.
product.routineCollagenMaskDesc: Use 2-3 times per week to complement your routine. The collagen mask provides intensive hydration and supports skin elasticity for enhanced anti-aging results.
product.routineSnowBoosterDescMoisturizing: After cleansing, apply the toner to moisturize and refine skin texture. It helps balance pH level and prepares your skin for deep hydration treatment.
product.routineHyaluronSerumDesc: Apply the serum with 4-step hydration technology. The coconut water base and hyaluronic acid complex deeply replenish moisture from within.
product.routineHyaluronCreamDesc: Finish with the cream to strengthen moisture barrier and lock in hydration. Provides long-lasting moisturization for up to 72 hours.
product.routineSoothingBombMaskDesc: Use 2-3 times per week for intensive moisture boost. The sea algae complex provides deep hydration and soothes the skin.
product.routineProblemControlTonerDesc: After cleansing, apply the toner to remove excess oil and sebum while adding quick hydration. This prepares your skin for the next steps.
product.routineProblemControlSerumDesc: Apply the serum to regulate excessive oil and sebum production. This helps fight breakouts and refines skin texture for clearer, healthier-looking skin.
product.routineProblemControlCreamDesc: Finish with the cream to control blemish-prone skin while keeping it hydrated. This provides ongoing protection and maintains moisture balance.
product.routineSoothingBombMaskDescProblem: Use the mask 2-3 times per week to complement your routine. It provides intensive relief and moisturizes skin with sea algae complex for enhanced results.
product.routineSnowBoosterDescMakeup: After cleansing, apply the toner to moisturize and refine skin texture. It helps balance pH level and prepares your skin for makeup application.
product.routineBBCushionDesc: Apply the BB cushion for natural coverage and skin protection. It covers redness and blemishes while providing SPF 50+ PA++++ protection for a flawless, radiant look.
product.routineMakeupRemoverDesc: At the end of the day, shake well and use the makeup remover to gently cleanse lip and eye makeup. The biphasic formula removes makeup without irritation while nourishing the delicate areas.
product.routineOvernightMaskDesc: Before bed, apply the overnight mask to revitalize and provide intensive care to fatigued skin. The oxygen capsules and pink ceramide complex work together to restore and protect your skin overnight.
product.routineSnowBoosterDescBrightening: After cleansing, apply the toner to moisturize and refine skin texture. It helps balance pH level and prepares your skin for the brightening treatment.
product.routineMultiVitaSerumDesc: Apply the vitamin-infused serum to brighten and energize your complexion. The 12-vitamin complex enhances your skin's natural radiance from within.
product.routineMultiVitaCreamDesc: Finish with the cream to maintain and protect your brightened skin. It forms a moisturizing barrier and continues to even skin tone for a luminous glow.
product.routinePeelingGelDesc: Use 1-2 times per week to remove dead skin cells and smooth texture. This gentle enzymatic peeling gel reveals brighter, smoother skin without irritation.
product.routineSoothingBombMaskDescBrightening: Use 2-3 times per week to complement your routine. It provides intensive hydration and soothes skin while enhancing the brightening effects.
product.routineBioMesoExpertDesc: For professional clinic use only. Apply the Expert Ampoule as directed — spicule-coated PDRN creates micro-channels that drive actives deep for intensive regeneration (typically once a month).
product.routineEyeSerumDesc: Pat a small amount of the peptide serum around the entire eye contour, morning and evening, to firm and smooth fine lines.
product.routineEyeCreamDesc: Seal in the serum with the eye contour cream — gentle tapping motions until absorbed, never rubbing the delicate eye area.
product.routineEyePatchDesc: 2-3 times a week, apply the peptide gel patches under clean eyes for 20-30 minutes for an intensive de-puffing and firming boost.
product.routinePostcreamDesc: Apply a generous layer to calm redness and support recovery — ideal after treatments, peeling or whenever skin feels stressed.
product.routineHydroSoothingCreamDesc: Finish with the hydro soothing cream to cool, calm and deeply moisturize — perfect for dehydrated or heat-stressed skin.
product.routineNDCellCreamDesc: Apply the clinical-grade ND Cell cream as your final evening step to intensively target wrinkles and loss of elasticity overnight.
product.routineUltraShieldSunDesc: Every morning, finish with SPF 50+ — the maximum-protection shield for the UAE sun. Reapply during extended time outdoors.
product.routineIntensiveBBDesc: Apply the BB cream as your final step for natural coverage, skin-caring actives and SPF 30 protection in one.
product.routinePeptideGelMaskDesc: 2-3 times a week, apply the peptide gel mask for 20-30 minutes to firm, lift and deeply nourish the skin.
product.routinePDRNMaskDesc: 2-3 times a week, apply the PDRN mask for 20 minutes to boost regeneration, elasticity and glow.
product.routineBioFermentMaskDesc: 1-2 times a week, mix the powder mask fresh, apply evenly, leave for 15-20 minutes and rinse — fermented actives renew and firm the skin.
product.routineHydroCoolMaskDesc: 1-2 times a week, mix and apply the modeling mask for 20-30 minutes — it cools, de-stresses and floods the skin with moisture.
product.routineEZCO2MaskDesc: Once a week, apply the carboxy mask for 20-30 minutes to boost circulation, oxygenation and skin vitality.
product.routinePDRNAmpouleDesc: Massage a thin layer into clean skin. Spicule-coated PDRN creates micro-channels for regeneration between professional treatments — never combine with a microneedle roller.
product.routineHyaluronSerumDescMicroneedling: Apply the hyaluron serum during and immediately after rolling — micro-channels multiply absorption of the multi-weight HA complex. Use only non-spicule serums with the roller.
product.routineMicroneedleRollerDesc: 1-2 times a week in the evening, roll gently in each direction over clean skin to create micro-channels that multiply active absorption.
product.routineScalpShampooTitle: HR³ Matrix Medi Scalp Shampoo α
product.routineScalpShampooDesc: Wash daily with the medicated scalp shampoo — massage into the scalp for 1-2 minutes before rinsing to clear buildup and refresh follicles.
product.routineScalpPeelingDesc: 1-2 times a week, apply the scalp peeling before shampooing to dissolve keratin buildup and sebum so actives can reach the follicles.
product.routineHairTonicDesc: Apply the tonic to towel-dry or dry scalp daily, focusing on thinning areas, and massage in — no rinsing needed.
product.routineHairSolutionDesc: Apply the concentrated solution to the scalp in sections and massage in — the peptide complex targets the causes of hair thinning.
product.routineScalpBrushDesc: Use the scalp brush daily for 2-3 minutes of massage to boost microcirculation and help tonic and solution absorb deeper.
product.routineHairStampDesc: 1-2 times a week, stamp the scalp gently to create micro-channels that dramatically improve absorption of the hair solution.
product.routineHairGenBoosterDesc: Use the HairGen Booster device on the scalp as directed to stimulate follicles and amplify the effect of the HR³ Matrix actives.
product.routineCerabarrierCleanserDesc: Cleanse morning and evening: massage the gel over damp skin and rinse. Pink Ceramide and the microbiome complex clean without stripping your moisture barrier.
product.routineMicrobiomeMistDesc: Mist immediately after cleansing to rebalance the skin's pH and microbiome and lock in the first layer of hydration.
product.routineMultiSunCreamDesc: In the morning, finish with SPF 40 to protect your renewed barrier from UV damage — essential under the UAE sun.
product.routineSnowBoosterDescSensitive: After cleansing, apply the gentle toner to soothe and hydrate sensitive skin. It helps restore balance without irritation and prepares your skin for the calming treatment.
product.routineAllForSensitiveSerumDesc: Apply the serum to calm and protect sensitive, reactive skin. The advanced formula with CELLASURE™ 5X strengthens skin barrier and reduces sensitivity.
product.routineSkinBarrierCreamTitle: Skin Barrier Protecting Cream with Ceramides
product.routineSkinBarrierCreamDesc: Finish with the ceramide cream to reinforce your skin's protective barrier. It provides long-lasting moisture and shields sensitive skin from external irritants.
product.routineEGFOxymaskDesc: Use 2-3 times per week for intensive repair. The EGF and oxygen bubbles revitalize and regenerate sensitive skin while providing deep nourishment.
product.routineSoothingBombMaskDescSensitive: Use 2-3 times per week to complement your routine. The sea algae complex provides deep calming hydration and soothes reactive, sensitive skin.
product.routineSnowBoosterDescRevitaGlow: After cleansing, apply the toner to hydrate and balance your skin. It refines skin texture and prepares the perfect base for your radiant glow routine.
product.routineHyaluronCreamDescRevitaGlow: Apply the hyaluron cream to deeply hydrate and plump your skin. This creates a smooth, moisturized canvas for flawless BB cream application.
product.routineRevitaGlowBBDesc: As the final step, apply the BB cream using the dedicated puff with gentle tapping motions. It provides natural coverage, UV protection (SPF 38 PA+++), and a radiant glass-like glow all day.

login.privacyPolicyDescription: By creating an account, you agree to our privacy policy regarding the collection and use of personal information.
login.privacyPolicyContent1: GENOSYS MIDDLE EAST FZ-LLC (hereinafter referred to as the "Company") processes the following types of personal information:
login.authenticationMethodsDescription: We offer two secure authentication methods: traditional email/password registration and Google OAuth authentication. Both methods are equally secure and comply with UAE data protection regulations.
login.requiredInformation: Required Information: ID, password (or Google authentication), name, nickname, email, mobile phone number
login.googleAuthenticationDescription: You may choose to sign in using your Google account. When you use Google Sign-In, Google shares certain information with us to create and manage your account:
login.googleDataShared: Data shared by Google includes: your email address, full name, and profile picture (if available). We do not receive or store your Google password. Your Google account password remains secure with Google and is never shared with us.
login.googlePrivacyPolicy: By using Google Sign-In, you also agree to Google's Privacy Policy and Terms of Service. Google's authentication is subject to Google's privacy practices, which you can review at https://policies.google.com/privacy
login.googleDataUsage: We use the information provided by Google solely for account creation, authentication, and service provision. This data is treated with the same level of security and privacy protection as information provided through traditional registration methods.
login.googleAccountLinking: If you already have an account registered with the same email address, signing in with Google will link your Google account to your existing account. You can continue to use either authentication method (email/password or Google Sign-In) to access your account.
login.googleDataControl: You maintain full control over your Google account data. You can revoke our access to your Google account at any time through your Google Account settings. However, revoking access will prevent you from using Google Sign-In until you re-authorize.
login.googleAlternative: You are not required to use Google Sign-In. You may always choose to create an account using email and password instead. Both authentication methods provide the same level of service and data protection.
login.automaticallyCollected: Automatically Collected Information During Internet Service Usage
login.ipAddress: IP address, cookies, MAC address, service usage history, visit records, records of improper use, etc.
login.purposeDescription: The Company processes personal information for the following purposes. Personal information will not be used for purposes other than those stated below. If the purpose of use changes, necessary measures such as obtaining separate consent in accordance with Article 18 of the Personal Information Protection Act will be implemented.
login.membershipManagement: To confirm membership registration intent, verify and authenticate users for membership-based services, maintain and manage membership status, enforce identity verification under the limited identity verification system, prevent fraudulent use of services, issue various notices and notifications, and handle user inquiries and complaints.
login.provisionOfServices: To provide services, deliver content, offer customized services, and verify users' identity.
login.handlingInquiriesDescription: To verify the identity of the complainant, check complaint details, conduct fact-checking, provide notifications regarding the investigation, and inform the results.
login.marketingDescription: To provide event and promotional information, offer participation opportunities, and generate statistics on users' service usage.
login.retentionPeriod: Retention and Use Period of Personal Information
login.retentionDescription: The Company processes and retains personal information within the period specified by relevant UAE laws and regulations or within the period agreed upon at the time of personal information collection.
login.untilWithdrawal: Until the user withdraws their membership from the Company's website.
login.investigationOngoing: However, if the following conditions apply, the information will be retained until the relevant situation is resolved:
login.investigationCondition: If an investigation or inquiry is ongoing due to a violation of related UAE laws, retention continues until the investigation or inquiry is concluded.
login.financialObligations: If there are outstanding financial obligations related to website usage, retention continues until the debts are settled.
login.untilCompletion: Until the completion of service provision, payment, and settlement of related charges.
login.rightToRefuse: Right to Refuse Consent to Collection and Use of Personal Information
login.rightToRefuseDescription: Users have the right to refuse consent to the collection and use of personal information.
login.essentialInformation: However, as the aforementioned personal information is essential for the operation of this website, users who do not consent to the collection and use of personal information may be restricted from membership registration and service usage.
login.consentAcknowledgment: By checking the consent box, submitting your information, or using Google Sign-In, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to the terms outlined in this Privacy Notice. When using Google Sign-In, you also consent to Google sharing your profile information with us as described above.
login.importantMessage: Please ensure you provide a valid UAE phone number and UAE address during registration.
login.invalidAccountWarning: Accounts with invalid or non-UAE contact information may be subject to deletion to maintain the integrity of our service.
login.privacyContact: For further inquiries regarding our privacy policy, please contact us at sales@genosys.ae

skinRecommendation.drySkinDescription: Skin that lacks moisture and may feel tight or flaky. Often has a rough texture, visible fine lines, and may appear dull.
skinRecommendation.drySkinTips: Focus on intensive hydration and barrier repair products with hyaluronic acid and ceramides.
skinRecommendation.oilySkinDescription: Skin that produces excess oil and may appear shiny, especially in the T-zone. Often has enlarged pores and is prone to blackheads and acne.
skinRecommendation.oilySkinTips: Use oil-controlling and mattifying products with salicylic acid or niacinamide to balance sebum production.
skinRecommendation.combinationSkinDescription: Skin that is oily in some areas (like T-zone) and dry in others. The forehead, nose, and chin may be oily while cheeks are dry.
skinRecommendation.combinationSkinTips: Use targeted care with different products for different areas, or balanced formulas that address both concerns.
skinRecommendation.normalSkinDescription: Well-balanced skin that is neither too oily nor too dry. Has a smooth texture, small pores, and good circulation.
skinRecommendation.normalSkinTips: Maintain your skin's natural balance with gentle, balanced products that preserve the skin's equilibrium.
skinRecommendation.sensitiveSkinDescription: Skin that reacts easily to products and environmental factors. Often experiences redness, irritation, burning, or stinging.
skinRecommendation.sensitiveSkinTips: Use hypoallergenic, fragrance-free products with soothing ingredients like aloe, chamomile, and centella asiatica.
skinRecommendation.teenFocus: Acne prevention, oil control, and establishing a basic routine
skinRecommendation.adultFocus: Anti-aging prevention, hydration, and skin repair
skinRecommendation.matureFocus: Advanced anti-aging, firming, and intensive repair
skinRecommendation.antiAgingDescription: Reduce fine lines, wrinkles, and signs of aging
skinRecommendation.acneBlemishesDescription: Clear acne, reduce blemishes, and prevent breakouts
skinRecommendation.acneBlemishesIngredients: Salicylic acid, benzoyl peroxide, niacinamide, tea tree
skinRecommendation.hydrationDescription: Boost moisture levels and prevent dehydration
skinRecommendation.brighteningDescription: Even skin tone and reduce dark spots
skinRecommendation.brighteningIngredients: Vitamin C, niacinamide, arbutin, licorice root
skinRecommendation.sensitivityDescription: Calm and soothe sensitive, reactive skin
skinRecommendation.sensitivityIngredients: Centella asiatica, aloe vera, chamomile, allantoin
skinRecommendation.poreCareDescription: Minimize pores and improve skin texture
skinRecommendation.eyeCareDescription: Target under-eye concerns and crow's feet
skinRecommendation.hairCareDescription: Hair care products including shampoo, tonic, and solutions
skinRecommendation.morningDescription: Start your day with protection and hydration
skinRecommendation.eveningDescription: Repair and restore while you sleep
